decisions.decision: Approval of the Lane Property Purchase & Sale Agreement was tabled to the April 1, 2014 BOS meeting; the BOS will post a meeting if approval is needed sooner.
decisions.quote: it was decided to table the approval of the purchase & sale agreement until the april 1, 2014 bos meeting to allow the contract to be completed

decisions.decision: Pete Lincoln's COA reappointment was tabled, and the BOS will review the COA Bylaws on appointments and term limits.
decisions.quote: mr. alonzo said that this appointment will be tabled for the time being.

decisions.decision: The BOS does not intend to appoint anyone to the PACC until after Annual Town Meeting, because of a Bylaw revision on the warrant.
decisions.quote: the bos does not intend to appoint anyone to that committee until after the annual town meeting.

decisions.decision: Maureen Dupuis was told that Agricultural Committee openings will be announced to the public when available.
decisions.quote: informed her that when an opening is available it will be announced to the public.

decisions.decision: The BOS will reconnect with Mr. Lafayette after further review of committee openings.
decisions.quote: the bos will reconnect with mr. lafayette after further review of committee openings.

decisions.decision: The BOS agreed that Steve Walker's experience would be welcomed on the PACC; he was thanked and not appointed in the minutes.
decisions.quote: the bos were in agreement that mr. walkers experience would be welcomed on the pacc

decisions.decision: Board decided a full site plan review of the school project was not necessary, but other Land Use Boards, particularly the Planning Board, should review it.
decisions.quote: after due and diligent discussion, board members decided that a full site plan review of the project was not necessary but that it would be helpful to have other land use boards, particularly the planning board, review the project.

decisions.decision: The Planning Board was asked to decide whether to review the project at the local level or hire a Peer Reviewer.
decisions.quote: ms. bertram requested that the planning board decide how they would like to proceed with this whether it be at the local level or hire a peer reviewer.

decisions.decision: The Board signed the Boys & Girls Club Week proclamation.
Warrant W#48-14 dated 3/18/2014 was signed (signature page signed).
